name: Quoting
summary: Turns a quote request into a priced quote in the business's own system, queues it to send, chases it, and hands a won quote over. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

service-minor-works.evidence: 49 discovery calls describe this way of quoting

covered_by.site-visit: skill (photos and notes into a proposal)

tender-from-plans.evidence: 114 discovery calls describe this way of quoting

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New quote requests from each intake source.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Price from the rate card, draft the quote, queue its send for approval.

crons.name: follow-up
crons.summary: Queue follow-ups on sent quotes that are due (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: handover
crons.summary: An accepted quote becomes a draft invoice, or nothing when the platform sets up the job.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a job in Quote status, its lines, a quote PDF filed to the job diary, a Xero quote, contact or invoice in DRAFT, an email draft, a register row. Anything that sends or changes a quote's status is a live operation and waits for a person.

xero.covers: quote, PDF, status, draft invoice; sending through the mailbox

microsoft-365.covers: Outlook intake, Excel rate card, Outlook drafts and sends, Excel quote register

gaps: Buildxact: runs the whole tender quote in product, but only its sign-in is mapped; its estimate and quote endpoints are needed.
Simpro and Buildertrend: help guides render only in a browser and the APIs are unmapped; free accounts needed.
Takeoff (Bluebeam markups export, Groundplan pushes) and subcontractor quote requests are agent-skill steps until their adapters exist.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox account (ServiceM8 trial, Xero demo company, Microsoft 365 developer tenant) proves it.

evidence.calls: 181 of 248 construction discovery calls that discuss quoting describe how they do it; 74 to 100 percent of every step is manual
evidence.platforms: the vendors' own help centres for Buildxact, ServiceM8, Bluebeam, Groundplan, Xero and EstimateOne, mapped step by step
